def test_segment_lines_renderable():
    lines = [[Segment("hello"), Segment(" "), Segment("world")], [Segment("foo")]]
    segment_lines = SegmentLines(lines)
    assert list(segment_lines.__rich_console__(None, None)) == [
        Segment("hello"),
        Segment(" "),
        Segment("world"),
        Segment("foo"),
    ]

    segment_lines = SegmentLines(lines, new_lines=True)
    assert list(segment_lines.__rich_console__(None, None)) == [
        Segment("hello"),
        Segment(" "),
        Segment("world"),
        Segment("\n"),
        Segment("foo"),
        Segment("\n"),
    ]

class ControlType(IntEnum):

    BELL = 1
    CARRIAGE_RETURN = 2
    HOME = 3
    CLEAR = 4
    SHOW_CURSOR = 5
    HIDE_CURSOR = 6
    ENABLE_ALT_SCREEN = 7

    CURSOR_MOVE_TO_COLUMN = 13
    CURSOR_MOVE_TO = 14
    ERASE_IN_LINE = 15
    SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16


ControlCode = Union[
    Tuple[ControlType],
    Tuple[ControlType, Union[int, str]],
    Tuple[ControlType, int, int],
]
